purpose: Material-side slice for modern business / office-power / chaebol-adjacent trends from KR serial platforms.
authority_note: Python only filters and formats transparent signals. Final relevance and concept judgment stay on the LLM side.

entry_fields.business_relevance_score: positive exact-match score minus noise penalty
entry_fields.business_buckets: matched lanes such as chaebol_power / office_operator / money_game / industry_scale / media_ip_business
entry_fields.positive_matches: transparent include-side keyword hits grouped by bucket
entry_fields.negative_matches: transparent noise-side keyword hits grouped by bucket
entry_fields.title_direct_hits: strong direct packaging words seen in the title itself

work_fields.surface_count: how many platform surfaces repeated this work in the slice
work_fields.max_business_relevance_score: best entry-level score across duplicated surfaces
